propositions: The workflow editor currently exposes authored YAML/BPMN without a trustworthy read-only view of the effective criteria policy derived from built-ins plus project overlays, risking misconfiguration and dual policy authority.

The editor must extend to obtain the S1 CriteriaSnapshot for the selected repository and expose a narrow, immutable Effective Policy view showing snapshot digest, criterion id, gate, tier, posture, applicability, and enabled/disabled state without serializing edits back to workflow.
Authoring/save validation must reject project code-review LLM criteria with missing, empty, non-list, or blank applies_to globs, offering the remedy use ["**"] for repository-wide applicability.
Built-in entries, project DET criteria, and plan-review criteria retain distinct trigger authoring controls and are not subject to the applies_to glob requirement.
Repository or validation errors during snapshot load must fail the save or mark the effective view unavailable with an actionable located message, never silently substituting packaged defaults.

The authored workflow document must round-trip byte-equivalently while the read-only effective policy view updates with project policy changes; payloads must exclude execution trace, provider response, prompt body, and secrets.
